reason: This is a cross-cutting change to the core expression constness contract, not a local cleanup. It touches `pkg/expression` primitives (`constant.go`, `expression.go`, `scalar_function.go`, `column.go`, constant propagation, many builtins) plus planner consumers (`logical_plan_builder`, partition processing, scalar subquery handling). A rename from `ConstItem` to `ConstLevel` strongly suggests semantic redefinition of what counts as constant and at what scope, which can affect constant folding, predicate simplification, partition pruning, and planner correctness across many queries. That is central and high-blast-radius enough to justify a focused deep review for Blocker/High issues.
